blends.name: Grand Treasure Hunt Pass: Q3 2026
blends.desc:
**Combine powerful Gilded Treasure Hunt Passes and rare materials to craft a legendary Grand Treasure Hunt Pass.**

**🔶 Costs:**
– 8x Gilded Treasure Hunt Pass (from Q3 2026)
– 20x Map Fragments (any type)
– 2x Golden Fang
– 1x Pirate's Relic
– 🔥 Burns 250 $RUM

🏴‍☠️ Each Grand Treasure Hunt Pass grants **1 reward share** in the **Quarterly 15,000 WAX Grand Treasure Pool**.

⚓ Additionally grants **1 entry** into the **Q3 Grand Fleet Raffle** featuring Mythic Ships, Mythic Pirates, and legendary Fleet Era rewards.

💠 Fleet Bonus:
Mythic Ships grant **+6% bonus** to WAX reward shares.
Mythic Pirates grant **+2% bonus** to WAX reward shares.

🎟 Raffle entries are based strictly on **Grand Pass ownership** — 1 Grand Pass = 1 raffle ticket.

Snapshot will be taken at the end of Q3. The more Grand Passes you hold, the greater your share of the rewards.

https://medium.com/@captainshelm/%EF%B8%8F-captains-helm-the-treasure-hunt-evolves-monthly-quarterly-beyond-f2f5d0315cc5

ing.note: Any Gilded Hunt Pass from Q3

blends.name: Pirate – First Mate – Mythic Upgrade
blends.desc:
# ⚓ FIRST MATE UPGRADE — MYTHIC

Three seasoned First Mates enter the Admiralty’s chamber. One stronger officer emerges.

Burn **3× Legendary First Mates**, the required crafting resources, and **$RUM** to receive:

## 🎁 RESULT

**1× Mythic First Mate**

First Mates are premium crew members who:

- Add significant personal fleet power
- Strengthen the class perks of other pirates aboard their ship
- Occupy one regular crew berth
- Are limited to one First Mate per ship

Higher-rarity First Mates provide greater personal power and stronger perk amplification.

## 🔥 REQUIREMENTS

- **3× Legendary First Mate**
- Required Fleet Era resources
- Required **$RUM**

All ingredients are permanently consumed.

Three officers surrender their commissions.  
One earns the captain’s right hand. 🏴‍☠️

blends.name: Ship – Command – Mythic Upgrade
blends.desc:
# 🏴‍☠️ COMMAND SHIP UPGRADE — MYTHIC

Three vessels sail into the Admiralty’s shipyard. One returns carrying the authority to command an entire bay.

Burn **3× Legendary Command Ships**, the required crafting resources, and **$RUM** to receive:

## 🎁 RESULT

**1× Mythic Command Ship**

Command Ships are specialist vessels that:

- Contribute ship power based on their rarity
- Strengthen the class perks supplied by the other classic ships in their bay
- Occupy one regular ship position
- Are limited to one Command Ship per bay

Higher-rarity Command Ships provide greater ship power and stronger command amplification.

## 🔥 REQUIREMENTS

- **3× Legendary Command Ship**
- Required Fleet Era resources
- Required **$RUM**

All ingredients are permanently consumed.

Three hulls are broken beneath the hammer.  
One flagship leaves the yard bearing absolute command. ⚔️

This blend permanently destroys a Gilded Pass and returns 15 $RUM,
closing its chapter as part of the Christmas Frenzy and the 2025 reset.

The wheel has stopped spinning.
Only the ashes remain.

Burn a 2025 Regular Treasure Hunt Pass and recover its final value.

Once used, the pass is gone forever — a final farewell to the 2025 Treasure Hunt era.

A clean end for a new beginning.

blends.name: Black Market: High Tides Booster to Ancient Key
blends.desc:
**Black Market — Tide-Forged Exchange**

*When the tides recede, their remnants still whisper of power.  
The Black Market accepts relics of the High Tide, reforging them into Ancient Keys sought by the bold and the patient.*

*No charm is ever truly spent — it merely changes hands.*

**Input:** Any expired High Tide Booster  
**Output:** Ancient Key  
**Availability:** Permanent

ing.note: Any High Tide Booster (use previous months)

blends.name: Captain's Eternal Reserve
blends.desc:
**Blend your way up the rum ladder!**
Combine 3 bottles of the lower rarity, burn $RUM, and use Twitch-earned resources to craft a stronger tier.
🧪 All bottles generate passive $RUM hourly on WaxDAO. Each tier earns 3× more than the last!

**🔥 Every blend burns $RUM + resources:**
* Uncommon: +1 Driftwood, 3 RUM
* Rare: +2 Driftwood, +1 Coral, 10 RUM
* Epic: +3 Driftwood, +2 Coral, +1 Kraken, 30 RUM
* Legendary: +4 Driftwood, +3 Coral, +2 Kraken, +1 Fang, 100 RUM
* Mythic: +5 Driftwood, +4 Coral, +3 Kraken, +2 Fang, +1 Relic, 300 RUM

**🏰 Mythic Bottles unlock monthly WAX revenue share + Discord role!**

Resources can only be obtained via Twitch !dig commands.
**This is your path to power — blend wisely, and stake for glory.**
https://waxdao.io/v2/farm/captainsrum

blends.desc:
**Blend your way up the rum ladder!**
Combine 3 bottles of the lower rarity, burn $RUM, and use Twitch-earned resources to craft a stronger tier.
🧪 All bottles generate passive $RUM hourly on WaxDAO. Each tier earns 3× more than the last!

**🔥 Every blend burns $RUM + resources:**
* Uncommon: +1 Driftwood, 3 RUM
* Rare: +2 Driftwood, +1 Coral, 10 RUM
* Epic: +3 Driftwood, +2 Coral, +1 Kraken, 30 RUM
* Legendary: +4 Driftwood, +3 Coral, +2 Kraken, +1 Fang, 100 RUM
* Mythic: +5 Driftwood, +4 Coral, +3 Kraken, +2 Fang, +1 Relic, 300 RUM

**🏰 Mythic Bottles unlock monthly WAX revenue share + Discord role!**

Resources can only be obtained via Twitch !dig commands.
**This is your path to power — blend wisely, and stake for glory.**
https://waxdao.io/v2/farm/captainsrum

blends.name: Ultimate Treasure - Helmsmen Only
blends.desc:
**⚓ Ultimate Treasure**
The most powerful chest in the Captain’s Helm collection. Grants a +20% lifetime boost to both !dig and !redeem actions.

**💎 Blend Requirements:**
• 2x Digger’s Treasures
• 2x Redeemer’s Treasures
**• Helmsman's Token required**

**🔒 LIMITED: Only 100 mints**
**🔐 1 Per Account**
🛂 Must be **manually whitelisted** (join 🦜crow’s-nest in our Discord after acquiring the token)

**✨ Stacking Info:**
Ultimate Treasure stacks with all previous boosters:
• +10% from Digger’s Map
• +10% from Redeemer’s Map
• +20% from Digger’s Treasure
• +20% from Redeemer’s Treasure
**→ Total boost: up to +50% to dig and redeem!**
